// Generated by vibelang prove from clamp.vibe. Do not edit.
// clamp.vibe:3
export function clamp(x: number, lo: number, hi: number): number {
    //@ verify
    if (x < lo)
        return lo;
    if (x > hi)
        return hi;
    return x;
}
// clamp.vibe:9
export function clampInRange(x: number, lo: number, hi: number): boolean {
    //@ verify
    //@ requires (lo <= hi)
    //@ ensures (lo <= clamp(x, lo, hi))
    //@ ensures (clamp(x, lo, hi) <= hi)
    return true;
}

// Generated by vibelang prove from search.vibe. Do not edit.
// search.vibe:2
export function linearSearch(xs: readonly number[], target: number): number {
    //@ verify
    //@ ensures (\result < xs.length)
    //@ ensures ((\result < 0) || (xs[\result] === target))
    let i = 0;
    while (i < xs.length) {
        //@ invariant (0 <= i)
        //@ invariant (i <= xs.length)
        //@ invariant (!xs.slice(0, i).includes(target))
        //@ decreases (xs.length - i)
        if (xs[i] === target)
            return i;
        i += 1;
    }
    return -1;
}
// search.vibe:20
export function searchFinds(xs: readonly number[], target: number): boolean {
    //@ verify
    const index = linearSearch(xs, target);
    //@ assert ((index >= 0) ==> (xs[index] === target))
    return true;
}
